name: mcp-tooling
description: Parent hub for ten MCP tool bridges: six workflow modes (mcp-chrome-devtools for browser inspection and debugging, mcp-click-up for ClickUp task management, mcp-obsidian for Obsidian vault and markdown-note management, mcp-aside-devtools for AI-browser automation, mcp-notion for Notion workspace operations, and mcp-orca-cli for Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, repositories, handoffs, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, comments, and embedded browser state) plus four read-only design transports (mcp-figma bridging to Figma Desktop, mcp-refero searching real-app UI references, mcp-mobbin researching mobile-app patterns, and mcp-magicpath looking up MagicPath components and design systems through its read-only vendor CLI over a UTCP cli manual). The advisor sees one hub identity and workflowMode selects the packet. mcp-code-mode is shared infrastructure, not a hub member.
